summary: Independent reviews find one P0 and five P1s: the sole design omitted the verified M6 6/44 genesis, replay input/exec identity remains incomplete, sealed state input lacks immutable snapshot semantics, and the fit/publication path still relies on in-process controls against an overbroad threat model.

limitations: Read-only independent reviews; no product/test/contract/gate/ledger mutation, training, server replay, budget consumption, real PIT certification, or final-OOS access.

blockers: M7 derived-contract freeze, real M7 fit, CCC/Gate experiments, server replay, and final OOS remain prohibited.
